booking.title: Online Appointment Booking
booking.intro: Enable or pause public online appointment booking for your salon's visitors here.
booking.enabled: Enabled — clients can book appointments online
booking.disabled: Disabled — online booking is hidden from visitors
booking.toggleDescription: When disabled, the online booking button is hidden on the public homepage and navigation bar, and the public booking endpoint remains locked.
booking.hint: Tip: Toggling this switch saves your preference immediately.

customers.title: Client Attributes (Custom Fields)

customers.labelPlaceholder: Label shown on client profile card
customers.keyLocked: The system key cannot be altered once saved!

inventory.title: Inventory Management
inventory.introBefore: Specify the date and time from which the system will deduct materials used during appointments. Completed bookings past their end time are flagged;
inventory.introStrong: only appointments starting after this timestamp
inventory.introAfter: will appear on the daily closing list.
inventory.recommendedOrder: Recommended workflow: upload products, assign default recipes to services, perform initial stocktaking, and only then enable inventory management. Stock pages (receipts, stocktaking) can be used beforehand.
inventory.hintBefore: Date adjustments will take effect upon clicking
inventory.hintAfter: at the bottom of the page. Leaving empty disables tracking.
inventory.enableConfirm: Are you sure you want to enable inventory tracking from now on? Appointments starting from this moment forward will be queued for daily closing.
inventory.disableConfirm: Are you sure you want to disable inventory tracking? Daily closing will be hidden until re-enabled.
